purpose: Say how probable it is that the venture is validated, from cited evidence: one record type per validation sub-score, a shared evidence item graded like GRADE, templates for gathering the evidence, and the references behind each default (EE-026). Starts with the problem sub-score; solution, product-market fit, pricing, go-to-market, team and operations readiness follow the same pattern. The problem is assessed without a single score (EE-050): four assumptions labelled from their evidence, the commitment they support (explore, prototype, charge, raise) and the next test, asking first when the record is incomplete; behaviors in features/problem-assessment.feature.
gaps: Jev does not score the probability yet; the example uses an owner value
Validation weights and floors are ours and unevaluated (version 0.x)
The single validation score (validation-score skill, purpose/validation/score) is held, not removed: EE-050 replaces it for the problem; the other sub-scores are not yet assessed the new way
